title: The Burst Statistics WordPress plugin before 3.7.5 does not verify that a request is actually being routed to its own…
description: The Burst Statistics WordPress plugin versions prior to 3.7.5 have a vulnerability where it does not verify if a request is routed to its own REST API before unloading other active plugins for that request. This flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass protections implemented by other plugins, such as REST access restrictions, hidden login pages, and two-factor authentication. Additionally, attackers can cause scheduled tasks of other plugins to be discarded.
